internal.title: Resolved: Kafka Consumer Lag High in Accounting Service
internal.body:
At 11:37 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert for high Kafka consumer lag was triggered in the accounting service. The lag reached 5200 records, accompanied by an elevated error rate and increased latency, indicating a backlog in processing Kafka messages.

Diagnosis confirmed a queue backlog as the root cause. At 11:57 UTC, a flag related to Kafka queue processing was disabled to mitigate the issue. Recovery was verified shortly after, with consumer lag metrics returning to normal levels.

The incident is now resolved. Monitoring continues to ensure stability.

external.title: Intermittent Processing Delays in Accounting Service Resolved
external.body: Between 11:37 and 11:57 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers may have experienced delays in transaction processing due to a backlog in message processing within our accounting service. The issue was identified and resolved promptly, and normal service has been restored. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

output.summary: High Kafka consumer lag caused a backlog in the accounting service message processing, leading to increased latency and error rates. The issue was resolved by disabling a processing flag, restoring normal operation.
output.impact: Customers experienced intermittent delays in transaction processing within the accounting service during the incident window.
output.root_cause: A backlog in Kafka message processing caused by high consumer lag in the accounting service.
output.resolution: Disabled a Kafka queue processing flag to clear the backlog and restore normal message consumption rates. Recovery was verified through monitoring of consumer lag metrics.

lessons.lesson: Monitor Kafka consumer lag closely and have automated alerts and remediation steps ready to address backlogs before they impact service latency and error rates.
lessons.applies_when: When Kafka consumer lag is high and a backlog flag is set, proactive monitoring and automated remediation can prevent service degradation.

action_items: Implement automated remediation for Kafka consumer lag backlogs.
Enhance monitoring dashboards to provide earlier warnings of queue backlogs.
